```{r,echo=FALSE}
# left_join() the SW data to the "..._sampled" data frame for each watershed-year combo

# WILLOW

# 2019
wc19_sampledSW_Veg <- wc19_sampled %>% 
  left_join(wc_SW_19_collapsed,
            by = "TP_ID") %>% 
  left_join(wc19_veg,
            by = "TP_ID") %>% 
  select(watershed,
         year,
         clusterID_seq,
         TP_ID,
         window_type,
         catchment_km2,
         riparian_area_m2,
         TO,
         p_mean,
         f_mean,
         dam_count_beav_all,
         dam_count_beav_conf,
         dam_count_ant,
         isAnthro,
         dam_intensity,
         SWA_t5,
         SWA_t6,
         SWA_t7,
         SWA_t8,
         Veg_area_veg19_0,
         Shape_Area_0,
         NDVI_veg19_0,
         Veg_area_veg19_10,
         Shape_Area_10,
         NDVI_veg19_10,
         Veg_area_veg19_20,
         Shape_Area_20,
         NDVI_veg19_20,
         Veg_area_veg19_30,
         Shape_Area_30,
         NDVI_veg19_30,
         containsNull_t5,
         containsNull_t6,
         containsNull_t7,
         containsNull_t8,
         window_start,
         window_end,
         window_length
         ) %>% 
  group_by(clusterID_seq,
           window_type) %>%
  summarise(watershed = first(watershed),
            year = first(year),
            window_length = first(window_length),
            
            # catchment_km2 at downstream terminus of sample window
            catchment_km2 = max(catchment_km2, na.rm = T),
            
            # total riparian area (m^2) in window
            riparian_area_m2 = sum(riparian_area_m2, na.rm = T),
            
            riparian_area_m2_0 = sum(Shape_Area_0, na.rm = T),
            
            riparian_area_m2_10 = sum(Shape_Area_10, na.rm = T),
            
            riparian_area_m2_20 = sum(Shape_Area_20, na.rm = T),
            
            riparian_area_m2_30 = sum(Shape_Area_30, na.rm = T),
            
            # avg TO of window
            TO = mean(TO, na.rm = T),
            
            # avg detection and fals pos. prob. for window
            p_window = mean(p_mean, na.rm = T),
            f_window = mean(f_mean, na.rm = T),
            
            # sum dam counts
            beav_count_all  = sum(dam_count_beav_all, na.rm = TRUE),
            beav_count_conf = sum(dam_count_beav_conf, na.rm = TRUE),
            anthro_count    = sum(dam_count_ant, na.rm = TRUE),
            isAnthro = first(isAnthro),
            
            # compute Nhat:
            Nhat = beav_count_all / (p_window * (1 - f_window)),
  
            # sum total surface water area for window
            SWA_t5 = sum(SWA_t5, na.rm = T),
            SWA_t6 = sum(SWA_t6, na.rm = T),
            SWA_t7 = sum(SWA_t7, na.rm = T),
            SWA_t8 = sum(SWA_t8, na.rm = T),
            
            # sum total veg area for each window at each buffer
            VA_0_t6 = sum(Veg_area_veg19_0, na.rm = T),
           
            
            VA_10_t6 = sum(Veg_area_veg19_10, na.rm = T),
            
            
            VA_20_t6 = sum(Veg_area_veg19_20, na.rm = T),
            
            
            VA_30_t6 = sum(Veg_area_veg19_30, na.rm = T),
            
            
            # mean & sd NDVI for window
            NDVI_0_t6 = mean(NDVI_veg19_0, na.rm = T),
           
            
            NDVI_10_t6 = mean(NDVI_veg19_10, na.rm = T),
            
            
            NDVI_20_t6 = mean(NDVI_veg19_20, na.rm = T),
            
            
            NDVI_30_t6 = mean(NDVI_veg19_30, na.rm = T),
            
            NDVI_sd_0_t6 = sd(NDVI_veg19_0,na.rm=T),
            NDVI_sd_10_t6 = sd(NDVI_veg19_10,na.rm=T),
            NDVI_sd_20_t6 = sd(NDVI_veg19_20,na.rm=T),
            NDVI_sd_30_t6 = sd(NDVI_veg19_30,na.rm=T),

            # take max isNull. if 1, then SWA should = NA due to satellite obfuscation;
            
            containsNull_t5 = max(containsNull_t5),
            containsNull_t6 = max(containsNull_t6),
            containsNull_t7 = max(containsNull_t7),
            containsNull_t8 = max(containsNull_t8),
            
            .groups = "drop"
  )

wc19_sampled_Long <- wc19_sampledSW_Veg %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(starts_with("SWA_t"), 
             starts_with("VA_0_t"), 
             starts_with("VA_10_t"),
             starts_with("VA_20_t"),
             starts_with("VA_30_t"),
             starts_with("NDVI_0_t"), 
             starts_with("NDVI_10_t"),
             starts_with("NDVI_20_t"),
             starts_with("NDVI_30_t"),
             starts_with("NDVI_sd_0_t"),
             starts_with("NDVI_sd_10_t"),
             starts_with("NDVI_sd_20_t"),
             starts_with("NDVI_sd_30_t"),
             starts_with("containsNull_t")),
    names_to = c(".value", "t"),
    names_pattern = "(.*)_t(\\d+)"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    t = as.factor(t)
  )

#wc19_lateSummer_Sample_Long <- wc19_sampled_Long %>%

# Mask SW/VEG data from windows with Null pixels for time t:

wc19_sampled_Long <- wc19_sampled_Long %>% 
  mutate(
    SWA     = ifelse(containsNull >= 1, NA, SWA),
    VA_0      = ifelse(containsNull >= 1, NA, VA_0),
    VA_10      = ifelse(containsNull >= 1, NA, VA_10),
    VA_20      = ifelse(containsNull >= 1, NA, VA_20),
    VA_30      = ifelse(containsNull >= 1, NA, VA_30),
    
    NDVI_0      = ifelse(containsNull >= 1, NA, NDVI_0),
    NDVI_10      = ifelse(containsNull >= 1, NA, NDVI_10),
    NDVI_20      = ifelse(containsNull >= 1, NA, NDVI_20),
    NDVI_30      = ifelse(containsNull >= 1, NA, NDVI_30),
    
    NDVI_sd_0 = ifelse(containsNull >= 1, NA, NDVI_sd_0),
    NDVI_sd_10 = ifelse(containsNull >= 1, NA, NDVI_sd_10),
    NDVI_sd_20 = ifelse(containsNull >= 1, NA, NDVI_sd_20),
    NDVI_sd_30 = ifelse(containsNull >= 1, NA, NDVI_sd_30),
  )

#PLOTS!
#Compare dam counts per sample window
wc19_damcounts <- wc19_sampled_Long %>%
  filter(window_type == "dammed") %>%
  select(clusterID_seq, beav_count_all)

wc19_damcounts <- wc19_damcounts %>%
  mutate(beav_count_all = beav_count_all,
         clusterID_seq = factor(clusterID_seq)) %>% 
  group_by(clusterID_seq) %>% 
  summarise(beav_count_all = max(beav_count_all))

ggplot(wc19_damcounts,
       aes(x = beav_count_all,
           fill = factor(clusterID_seq))) +
  geom_bar(color = "black", width = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = colorRampPalette(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(12, "Paired"))(60),
    name = "Cluster ID"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Dam Count per Cluster Window",
    y = "Number of Dammed Clusters",
    title = "Distribution of Dam Counts Across Sampled Dammed Clusters",
    subtitle = "WC19"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```

```{r,echo=FALSE}
            catchment_km2 = max(catchment_km2, na.rm = T),
            
            # total riparian area (m^2) in window
            riparian_area_m2 = sum(riparian_area_m2, na.rm = T),
            
            riparian_area_m2_0 = sum(Shape_Area_0, na.rm = T),
            
            riparian_area_m2_10 = sum(Shape_Area_10, na.rm = T),
            
            riparian_area_m2_20 = sum(Shape_Area_20, na.rm = T),
            
            riparian_area_m2_30 = sum(Shape_Area_30, na.rm = T),
            
            # avg TO of window
            TO = mean(TO, na.rm = T),
            
            # avg detection and fals pos. prob. for window
            p_window = mean(p_mean, na.rm = T),
            f_window = mean(f_mean, na.rm = T),
            
            # sum dam counts
            beav_count_all  = sum(dam_count_beav_all, na.rm = TRUE),
            beav_count_conf = sum(dam_count_beav_conf, na.rm = TRUE),
            anthro_count    = sum(dam_count_ant, na.rm = TRUE),
            isAnthro = first(isAnthro),
            
            # compute Nhat:
            Nhat = beav_count_all / (p_window * (1 - f_window)),
  
            # sum total surface water area for window
            SWA_t5 = sum(SWA_t5, na.rm = T),
            SWA_t6 = sum(SWA_t6, na.rm = T),
            SWA_t7 = sum(SWA_t7, na.rm = T),
            SWA_t8 = sum(SWA_t8, na.rm = T),
            
            # sum total veg area for each window at each buffer
            VA_0_t6 = sum(Veg_area_veg21_0, na.rm = T),
           
            
            VA_10_t6 = sum(Veg_area_veg21_10, na.rm = T),
            
            
            VA_20_t6 = sum(Veg_area_veg21_20, na.rm = T),
            
            
            VA_30_t6 = sum(Veg_area_veg21_30, na.rm = T),
            
            
            # mean & sd NDVI for window
            NDVI_0_t6 = mean(NDVI_veg21_0, na.rm = T),
           
            
            NDVI_10_t6 = mean(NDVI_veg21_10, na.rm = T),
            
            
            NDVI_20_t6 = mean(NDVI_veg21_20, na.rm = T),
            
            
            NDVI_30_t6 = mean(NDVI_veg21_30, na.rm = T),
            
            NDVI_sd_0_t6 = sd(NDVI_veg21_0,na.rm=T),
            NDVI_sd_10_t6 = sd(NDVI_veg21_10,na.rm=T),
            NDVI_sd_20_t6 = sd(NDVI_veg21_20,na.rm=T),
            NDVI_sd_30_t6 = sd(NDVI_veg21_30,na.rm=T),

            # take max isNull. if 1, then SWA should = NA due to satellite obfuscation;
            
            containsNull_t5 = max(containsNull_t5),
            containsNull_t6 = max(containsNull_t6),
            containsNull_t7 = max(containsNull_t7),
            containsNull_t8 = max(containsNull_t8),
            
            .groups = "drop"
  )

wc21_sampled_Long <- wc21_sampledSW_Veg %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(starts_with("SWA_t"), 
             starts_with("VA_0_t"), 
             starts_with("VA_10_t"),
             starts_with("VA_20_t"),
             starts_with("VA_30_t"),
             starts_with("NDVI_0_t"), 
             starts_with("NDVI_10_t"),
             starts_with("NDVI_20_t"),
             starts_with("NDVI_30_t"),
             starts_with("NDVI_sd_0_t"),
             starts_with("NDVI_sd_10_t"),
             starts_with("NDVI_sd_20_t"),
             starts_with("NDVI_sd_30_t"),
             starts_with("containsNull_t")),
    names_to = c(".value", "t"),
    names_pattern = "(.*)_t(\\d+)"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    t = as.factor(t)
  )

    VA_20      = ifelse(containsNull >= 1, NA, VA_20),
    VA_30      = ifelse(containsNull >= 1, NA, VA_30),
    
    NDVI_0      = ifelse(containsNull >= 1, NA, NDVI_0),
    NDVI_10      = ifelse(containsNull >= 1, NA, NDVI_10),
    NDVI_20      = ifelse(containsNull >= 1, NA, NDVI_20),
    NDVI_30      = ifelse(containsNull >= 1, NA, NDVI_30),
    
    NDVI_sd_0 = ifelse(containsNull >= 1, NA, NDVI_sd_0),
    NDVI_sd_10 = ifelse(containsNull >= 1, NA, NDVI_sd_10),
    NDVI_sd_20 = ifelse(containsNull >= 1, NA, NDVI_sd_20),
    NDVI_sd_30 = ifelse(containsNull >= 1, NA, NDVI_sd_30),
  )
```

```{r,echo=FALSE}
# left_join() the SW data to the "..._sampled" data frame for each watershed-year combo

# LONE TREE 

# 2019
lt19_sampledSW_Veg <- lt19_sampled %>% 
  left_join(lt_SW_19_collapsed,
            by = "TP_ID") %>% 
  left_join(lt19_veg,
            by = "TP_ID") %>% 
  select(watershed,
         year,
         clusterID_seq,
         TP_ID,
         window_type,
         catchment_km2,
         riparian_area_m2,
         TO,
         p_mean,
         f_mean,
         dam_count_beav_all,
         dam_count_beav_conf,
         dam_count_ant,
         isAnthro,
         dam_intensity,
         SWA_t5,
         SWA_t6,
         SWA_t7,
         SWA_t8,
         Veg_area_veg19_0,
         Shape_Area_0,
         NDVI_veg19_0,
         Veg_area_veg19_10,
         Shape_Area_10,
         NDVI_veg19_10,
         Veg_area_veg19_20,
         Shape_Area_20,
         NDVI_veg19_20,
         Veg_area_veg19_30,
         Shape_Area_30,
         NDVI_veg19_30,
         containsNull_t5,
         containsNull_t6,
         containsNull_t7,
         containsNull_t8,
         window_start,
         window_end,
         window_length
         ) %>% 
  group_by(clusterID_seq,
           window_type) %>%
  summarise(watershed = first(watershed),
            year = first(year),
            window_length = first(window_length),
            
            # catchment_km2 at downstream terminus of sample window
            catchment_km2 = max(catchment_km2, na.rm = T),
            
            # total riparian area (m^2) in window
            riparian_area_m2 = sum(riparian_area_m2, na.rm = T),
            
            riparian_area_m2_0 = sum(Shape_Area_0, na.rm = T),
            
            riparian_area_m2_10 = sum(Shape_Area_10, na.rm = T),
            
            riparian_area_m2_20 = sum(Shape_Area_20, na.rm = T),
            
            riparian_area_m2_30 = sum(Shape_Area_30, na.rm = T),
            
            # avg TO of window
            TO = mean(TO, na.rm = T),
            
            # avg detection and fals pos. prob. for window
            p_window = mean(p_mean, na.rm = T),
            f_window = mean(f_mean, na.rm = T),
            
            # sum dam counts
            beav_count_all  = sum(dam_count_beav_all, na.rm = TRUE),
            beav_count_conf = sum(dam_count_beav_conf, na.rm = TRUE),
            anthro_count    = sum(dam_count_ant, na.rm = TRUE),
            isAnthro = first(isAnthro),
            
            # compute Nhat:
            Nhat = beav_count_all / (p_window * (1 - f_window)),
  
            # sum total surface water area for window
            SWA_t5 = sum(SWA_t5, na.rm = T),
            SWA_t6 = sum(SWA_t6, na.rm = T),
            SWA_t7 = sum(SWA_t7, na.rm = T),
            SWA_t8 = sum(SWA_t8, na.rm = T),
            
            # sum total veg area for each window at each buffer
            VA_0_t6 = sum(Veg_area_veg19_0, na.rm = T),
           
            
            VA_10_t6 = sum(Veg_area_veg19_10, na.rm = T),
            
            
            VA_20_t6 = sum(Veg_area_veg19_20, na.rm = T),
            
            
            VA_30_t6 = sum(Veg_area_veg19_30, na.rm = T),
            
            
            # mean & sd NDVI for window
            NDVI_0_t6 = mean(NDVI_veg19_0, na.rm = T),
           
            
            NDVI_10_t6 = mean(NDVI_veg19_10, na.rm = T),
            
            
            NDVI_20_t6 = mean(NDVI_veg19_20, na.rm = T),
            
            
            NDVI_30_t6 = mean(NDVI_veg19_30, na.rm = T),
            
            NDVI_sd_0_t6 = sd(NDVI_veg19_0,na.rm=T),
            NDVI_sd_10_t6 = sd(NDVI_veg19_10,na.rm=T),
            NDVI_sd_20_t6 = sd(NDVI_veg19_20,na.rm=T),
            NDVI_sd_30_t6 = sd(NDVI_veg19_30,na.rm=T),

            # take max isNull. if 1, then SWA should = NA due to satellite obfuscation;
            
            containsNull_t5 = max(containsNull_t5),
            containsNull_t6 = max(containsNull_t6),
            containsNull_t7 = max(containsNull_t7),
            containsNull_t8 = max(containsNull_t8),
            
            .groups = "drop"
  )

lt19_sampled_Long <- lt19_sampledSW_Veg %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(starts_with("SWA_t"), 
             starts_with("VA_0_t"), 
             starts_with("VA_10_t"),
             starts_with("VA_20_t"),
             starts_with("VA_30_t"),
             starts_with("NDVI_0_t"), 
             starts_with("NDVI_10_t"),
             starts_with("NDVI_20_t"),
             starts_with("NDVI_30_t"),
             starts_with("NDVI_sd_0_t"),
             starts_with("NDVI_sd_10_t"),
             starts_with("NDVI_sd_20_t"),
             starts_with("NDVI_sd_30_t"),
             starts_with("containsNull_t")),
    names_to = c(".value", "t"),
    names_pattern = "(.*)_t(\\d+)"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    t = as.factor(t)
  )

#lt19_lateSummer_Sample_Long <- lt19_sampled_Long %>% 
#  filter(t %in% c(5,6,7,8))


# Mask SW/VEG data from windows with Null pixels for time t:

lt19_sampled_Long <- lt19_sampled_Long %>% 
  mutate(
    SWA     = ifelse(containsNull >= 1, NA, SWA),
    VA_0      = ifelse(containsNull >= 1, NA, VA_0),
    VA_10      = ifelse(containsNull >= 1, NA, VA_10),
    VA_20      = ifelse(containsNull >= 1, NA, VA_20),
    VA_30      = ifelse(containsNull >= 1, NA, VA_30),
    
    NDVI_0      = ifelse(containsNull >= 1, NA, NDVI_0),
    NDVI_10      = ifelse(containsNull >= 1, NA, NDVI_10),
    NDVI_20      = ifelse(containsNull >= 1, NA, NDVI_20),
    NDVI_30      = ifelse(containsNull >= 1, NA, NDVI_30),
    
    NDVI_sd_0 = ifelse(containsNull >= 1, NA, NDVI_sd_0),
    NDVI_sd_10 = ifelse(containsNull >= 1, NA, NDVI_sd_10),
    NDVI_sd_20 = ifelse(containsNull >= 1, NA, NDVI_sd_20),
    NDVI_sd_30 = ifelse(containsNull >= 1, NA, NDVI_sd_30),
  )
```

```{r,echo=FALSE}
            SWA_t6 = sum(SWA_t6, na.rm = T),
            SWA_t7 = sum(SWA_t7, na.rm = T),
            SWA_t8 = sum(SWA_t8, na.rm = T),
            
            # sum total veg area for each window at each buffer
            VA_0_t6 = sum(Veg_area_veg21_0, na.rm = T),
           
            
            VA_10_t6 = sum(Veg_area_veg21_10, na.rm = T),
            
            
            VA_20_t6 = sum(Veg_area_veg21_20, na.rm = T),
            
            
            VA_30_t6 = sum(Veg_area_veg21_30, na.rm = T),
            
            
            # mean & sd NDVI for window
            NDVI_0_t6 = mean(NDVI_veg21_0, na.rm = T),
           
            
            NDVI_10_t6 = mean(NDVI_veg21_10, na.rm = T),
            
            
            NDVI_20_t6 = mean(NDVI_veg21_20, na.rm = T),
            
            
            NDVI_30_t6 = mean(NDVI_veg21_30, na.rm = T),
            
            NDVI_sd_0_t6 = sd(NDVI_veg21_0,na.rm=T),
            NDVI_sd_10_t6 = sd(NDVI_veg21_10,na.rm=T),
            NDVI_sd_20_t6 = sd(NDVI_veg21_20,na.rm=T),
            NDVI_sd_30_t6 = sd(NDVI_veg21_30,na.rm=T),

            # take max isNull. if 1, then SWA should = NA due to satellite obfuscation;
            
            containsNull_t5 = max(containsNull_t5),
            containsNull_t6 = max(containsNull_t6),
            containsNull_t7 = max(containsNull_t7),
            containsNull_t8 = max(containsNull_t8),
            
            .groups = "drop"
  )

lt21_sampled_Long <- lt21_sampledSW_Veg %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(starts_with("SWA_t"), 
             starts_with("VA_0_t"), 
             starts_with("VA_10_t"),
             starts_with("VA_20_t"),
             starts_with("VA_30_t"),
             starts_with("NDVI_0_t"), 
             starts_with("NDVI_10_t"),
             starts_with("NDVI_20_t"),
             starts_with("NDVI_30_t"),
             starts_with("NDVI_sd_0_t"),
             starts_with("NDVI_sd_10_t"),
             starts_with("NDVI_sd_20_t"),
             starts_with("NDVI_sd_30_t"),
             starts_with("containsNull_t")),
    names_to = c(".value", "t"),
    names_pattern = "(.*)_t(\\d+)"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    t = as.factor(t)
  )

# Mask SW/VEG data from windows with Null pixels for time t:

    VA_0      = ifelse(containsNull >= 1, NA, VA_0),

    VA_30      = ifelse(containsNull >= 1, NA, VA_30),
    
    NDVI_0      = ifelse(containsNull >= 1, NA, NDVI_0),
    NDVI_10      = ifelse(containsNull >= 1, NA, NDVI_10),
    NDVI_20      = ifelse(containsNull >= 1, NA, NDVI_20),
    NDVI_30      = ifelse(containsNull >= 1, NA, NDVI_30),
    
    NDVI_sd_0 = ifelse(containsNull >= 1, NA, NDVI_sd_0),
    NDVI_sd_10 = ifelse(containsNull >= 1, NA, NDVI_sd_10),
    NDVI_sd_20 = ifelse(containsNull >= 1, NA, NDVI_sd_20),
```

```{r,echo=FALSE}
# left_join() the SW data to the "..._sampled" data frame for each watershed-year combo

# Lone Tree

# 2023
lt23_sampledSW_Veg <- lt23_sampled %>% 
  left_join(lt_SW_23_collapsed,
            by = "TP_ID") %>% 
  left_join(lt23_veg,
            by = "TP_ID") %>% 
  select(watershed,
         year,
         clusterID_seq,
         TP_ID,
         window_type,
         catchment_km2,
         riparian_area_m2,
         TO,
         p_mean,
         f_mean,
         dam_count_beav_all,
         dam_count_beav_conf,
         dam_count_ant,
         isAnthro,
         dam_intensity,
         SWA_t5,
         SWA_t6,
         SWA_t7,
         SWA_t8,
         Veg_area_veg23_0,
         Shape_Area_0,
         NDVI_veg23_0,
         Veg_area_veg23_10,
         Shape_Area_10,
         NDVI_veg23_10,
         Veg_area_veg23_20,
         Shape_Area_20,
         NDVI_veg23_20,
         Veg_area_veg23_30,
         Shape_Area_30,
         NDVI_veg23_30,
         containsNull_t5,
         containsNull_t6,
         containsNull_t7,
         containsNull_t8,
         window_start,
         window_end,
         window_length
         ) %>% 
  group_by(clusterID_seq,
           window_type) %>%
  summarise(watershed = first(watershed),
            year = first(year),
            window_length = first(window_length),
            
            # catchment_km2 at downstream terminus of sample window
            catchment_km2 = max(catchment_km2, na.rm = T),
            
            # total riparian area (m^2) in window
            riparian_area_m2 = sum(riparian_area_m2, na.rm = T),
            
            riparian_area_m2_0 = sum(Shape_Area_0, na.rm = T),
            
            riparian_area_m2_10 = sum(Shape_Area_10, na.rm = T),
            
            riparian_area_m2_20 = sum(Shape_Area_20, na.rm = T),
            
            riparian_area_m2_30 = sum(Shape_Area_30, na.rm = T),
            
            # avg TO of window
            TO = mean(TO, na.rm = T),
            
            # avg detection and fals pos. prob. for window
            p_window = mean(p_mean, na.rm = T),
            f_window = mean(f_mean, na.rm = T),
            
            # sum dam counts
            beav_count_all  = sum(dam_count_beav_all, na.rm = TRUE),
            beav_count_conf = sum(dam_count_beav_conf, na.rm = TRUE),
            anthro_count    = sum(dam_count_ant, na.rm = TRUE),
            isAnthro = first(isAnthro),
            
            # compute Nhat:
            Nhat = beav_count_all / (p_window * (1 - f_window)),
  
            # sum total surface water area for window
            SWA_t5 = sum(SWA_t5, na.rm = T),
            SWA_t6 = sum(SWA_t6, na.rm = T),
            SWA_t7 = sum(SWA_t7, na.rm = T),
            SWA_t8 = sum(SWA_t8, na.rm = T),
            
            # sum total veg area for each window at each buffer
            VA_0_t6 = sum(Veg_area_veg23_0, na.rm = T),
           
            
            VA_10_t6 = sum(Veg_area_veg23_10, na.rm = T),
            
            
            VA_20_t6 = sum(Veg_area_veg23_20, na.rm = T),
            
            
            VA_30_t6 = sum(Veg_area_veg23_30, na.rm = T),
            
            
            # mean & sd NDVI for window
            NDVI_0_t6 = mean(NDVI_veg23_0, na.rm = T),
           
            
            NDVI_10_t6 = mean(NDVI_veg23_10, na.rm = T),
            
            
            NDVI_20_t6 = mean(NDVI_veg23_20, na.rm = T),
            
            
            NDVI_30_t6 = mean(NDVI_veg23_30, na.rm = T),
            
            NDVI_sd_0_t6 = sd(NDVI_veg23_0,na.rm=T),
            NDVI_sd_10_t6 = sd(NDVI_veg23_10,na.rm=T),
            NDVI_sd_20_t6 = sd(NDVI_veg23_20,na.rm=T),
            NDVI_sd_30_t6 = sd(NDVI_veg23_30,na.rm=T),

            # take max isNull. if 1, then SWA should = NA due to satellite obfuscation;
            
            containsNull_t5 = max(containsNull_t5),
            containsNull_t6 = max(containsNull_t6),
            containsNull_t7 = max(containsNull_t7),
            containsNull_t8 = max(containsNull_t8),
            
            .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r,echo=FALSE}
# left_join() the SW data to the "..._sampled" data frame for each watershed-year combo

# BRAZIL

# 2019
brz19_sampledSW_Veg <- brz19_sampled %>% 
  left_join(brz_SW_19_collapsed,
            by = "TP_ID") %>% 
  left_join(brz19_veg,
            by = "TP_ID") %>% 
  select(watershed,
         year,
         clusterID_seq,
         TP_ID,
         window_type,
         catchment_km2,
         riparian_area_m2,
         TO,
         p_mean,
         f_mean,
         dam_count_beav_all,
         dam_count_beav_conf,
         dam_count_ant,
         isAnthro,
         dam_intensity,
         SWA_t5,
         SWA_t6,
         SWA_t7,
         SWA_t8,
         Veg_area_veg19_0,
         Shape_Area_0,
         NDVI_veg19_0,
         Veg_area_veg19_10,
         Shape_Area_10,
         NDVI_veg19_10,
         Veg_area_veg19_20,
         Shape_Area_20,
         NDVI_veg19_20,
         Veg_area_veg19_30,
         Shape_Area_30,
         NDVI_veg19_30,
         containsNull_t5,
         containsNull_t6,
         containsNull_t7,
         containsNull_t8,
         window_start,
         window_end,
         window_length
         ) %>% 
  group_by(clusterID_seq,
           window_type) %>%
  summarise(watershed = first(watershed),
            year = first(year),
            window_length = first(window_length),
            
            # catchment_km2 at downstream terminus of sample window
            catchment_km2 = max(catchment_km2, na.rm = T),
            
            # total riparian area (m^2) in window
            riparian_area_m2 = sum(riparian_area_m2, na.rm = T),
            
            riparian_area_m2_0 = sum(Shape_Area_0, na.rm = T),
            
            riparian_area_m2_10 = sum(Shape_Area_10, na.rm = T),
            
            riparian_area_m2_20 = sum(Shape_Area_20, na.rm = T),
            
            riparian_area_m2_30 = sum(Shape_Area_30, na.rm = T),
            
            # avg TO of window
            TO = mean(TO, na.rm = T),
            
            # avg detection and fals pos. prob. for window
            p_window = mean(p_mean, na.rm = T),
            f_window = mean(f_mean, na.rm = T),
            
            # sum dam counts
            beav_count_all  = sum(dam_count_beav_all, na.rm = TRUE),
            beav_count_conf = sum(dam_count_beav_conf, na.rm = TRUE),
            anthro_count    = sum(dam_count_ant, na.rm = TRUE),
            isAnthro = first(isAnthro),
            
            # compute Nhat:
            Nhat = beav_count_all / (p_window * (1 - f_window)),
  
            # sum total surface water area for window
            SWA_t5 = sum(SWA_t5, na.rm = T),
            SWA_t6 = sum(SWA_t6, na.rm = T),
            SWA_t7 = sum(SWA_t7, na.rm = T),
            SWA_t8 = sum(SWA_t8, na.rm = T),
            
            # sum total veg area for each window at each buffer
            VA_0_t6 = sum(Veg_area_veg19_0, na.rm = T),
           
            
            VA_10_t6 = sum(Veg_area_veg19_10, na.rm = T),
            
            
            VA_20_t6 = sum(Veg_area_veg19_20, na.rm = T),
            
            
            VA_30_t6 = sum(Veg_area_veg19_30, na.rm = T),
            
            
            # mean & sd NDVI for window
            NDVI_0_t6 = mean(NDVI_veg19_0, na.rm = T),
           
            
            NDVI_10_t6 = mean(NDVI_veg19_10, na.rm = T),
            
            
            NDVI_20_t6 = mean(NDVI_veg19_20, na.rm = T),
            
            
            NDVI_30_t6 = mean(NDVI_veg19_30, na.rm = T),
            
            NDVI_sd_0_t6 = sd(NDVI_veg19_0,na.rm=T),
            NDVI_sd_10_t6 = sd(NDVI_veg19_10,na.rm=T),
            NDVI_sd_20_t6 = sd(NDVI_veg19_20,na.rm=T),
            NDVI_sd_30_t6 = sd(NDVI_veg19_30,na.rm=T),

            # take max isNull. if 1, then SWA should = NA due to satellite obfuscation;
            
            containsNull_t5 = max(containsNull_t5),
            containsNull_t6 = max(containsNull_t6),
            containsNull_t7 = max(containsNull_t7),
            containsNull_t8 = max(containsNull_t8),
            
            .groups = "drop"
  )

brz19_sampled_Long <- brz19_sampledSW_Veg %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(starts_with("SWA_t"), 
             starts_with("VA_0_t"), 
             starts_with("VA_10_t"),
             starts_with("VA_20_t"),
             starts_with("VA_30_t"),
             starts_with("NDVI_0_t"), 
             starts_with("NDVI_10_t"),
             starts_with("NDVI_20_t"),
             starts_with("NDVI_30_t"),
             starts_with("NDVI_sd_0_t"),
             starts_with("NDVI_sd_10_t"),
             starts_with("NDVI_sd_20_t"),
             starts_with("NDVI_sd_30_t"),
             starts_with("containsNull_t")),
    names_to = c(".value", "t"),
    names_pattern = "(.*)_t(\\d+)"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    t = as.factor(t)
  )

#brz19_lateSummer_Sample_Long <- brz19_sampled_Long %>% 
#  filter(t %in% c(5,6,7,8))


# Mask SW/VEG data from windows with Null pixels for time t:

brz19_sampled_Long <- brz19_sampled_Long %>% 
  mutate(
    SWA     = ifelse(containsNull >= 1, NA, SWA),
    VA_0      = ifelse(containsNull >= 1, NA, VA_0),
    VA_10      = ifelse(containsNull >= 1, NA, VA_10),
    VA_20      = ifelse(containsNull >= 1, NA, VA_20),
    VA_30      = ifelse(containsNull >= 1, NA, VA_30),
    
    NDVI_0      = ifelse(containsNull >= 1, NA, NDVI_0),
    NDVI_10      = ifelse(containsNull >= 1, NA, NDVI_10),
    NDVI_20      = ifelse(containsNull >= 1, NA, NDVI_20),
    NDVI_30      = ifelse(containsNull >= 1, NA, NDVI_30),
    
    NDVI_sd_0 = ifelse(containsNull >= 1, NA, NDVI_sd_0),
    NDVI_sd_10 = ifelse(containsNull >= 1, NA, NDVI_sd_10),
    NDVI_sd_20 = ifelse(containsNull >= 1, NA, NDVI_sd_20),
    NDVI_sd_30 = ifelse(containsNull >= 1, NA, NDVI_sd_30),
  )

#PLOTS!
#Compare dam counts per sample window
brz19_damcounts <- brz19_sampled_Long %>%
  filter(window_type == "dammed") %>%
  select(clusterID_seq, beav_count_all)

brz19_damcounts <- brz19_damcounts %>%
  mutate(beav_count_all = beav_count_all,
         clusterID_seq = factor(clusterID_seq)) %>% 
  group_by(clusterID_seq) %>% 
  summarise(beav_count_all = max(beav_count_all))

ggplot(brz19_damcounts,

    subtitle = "brz19"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +

    legend.position = "right",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```

```{r,echo=FALSE}
            # take max isNull. if 1, then SWA should = NA due to satellite obfuscation;
            
            containsNull_t5 = max(containsNull_t5),
            containsNull_t6 = max(containsNull_t6),
            containsNull_t7 = max(containsNull_t7),
            containsNull_t8 = max(containsNull_t8),
            
            .groups = "drop"
  )

brz21_sampled_Long <- brz21_sampledSW_Veg %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(starts_with("SWA_t"), 
             starts_with("VA_0_t"), 
             starts_with("VA_10_t"),
             starts_with("VA_20_t"),
             starts_with("VA_30_t"),
             starts_with("NDVI_0_t"), 
             starts_with("NDVI_10_t"),
             starts_with("NDVI_20_t"),
             starts_with("NDVI_30_t"),
             starts_with("NDVI_sd_0_t"),
             starts_with("NDVI_sd_10_t"),
             starts_with("NDVI_sd_20_t"),
             starts_with("NDVI_sd_30_t"),

  ) %>%
  mutate(
    t = as.factor(t)
  )

# Mask SW/VEG data from windows with Null pixels for time t:

  mutate(
    SWA     = ifelse(containsNull >= 1, NA, SWA),
    VA_0      = ifelse(containsNull >= 1, NA, VA_0),

    NDVI_20      = ifelse(containsNull >= 1, NA, NDVI_20),
```

```{r,echo=FALSE}
# left_join() the SW data to the "..._sampled" data frame for each watershed-year combo

# Brazil

# 2023
brz23_sampledSW_Veg <- brz23_sampled %>% 
  left_join(brz_SW_23_collapsed,
            by = "TP_ID") %>% 
  left_join(brz23_veg,
            by = "TP_ID") %>% 
  select(watershed,
         year,
         clusterID_seq,
         TP_ID,
         window_type,
         catchment_km2,
         riparian_area_m2,
         TO,
         p_mean,
         f_mean,
         dam_count_beav_all,
         dam_count_beav_conf,
         dam_count_ant,
         isAnthro,
         dam_intensity,
         SWA_t5,
         SWA_t6,
         SWA_t7,
         SWA_t8,
         Veg_area_veg23_0,
         Shape_Area_0,
         NDVI_veg23_0,
         Veg_area_veg23_10,
         Shape_Area_10,
         NDVI_veg23_10,
         Veg_area_veg23_20,
         Shape_Area_20,
         NDVI_veg23_20,
         Veg_area_veg23_30,
         Shape_Area_30,
         NDVI_veg23_30,
         containsNull_t5,
         containsNull_t6,
         containsNull_t7,
         containsNull_t8,
         window_start,
         window_end,
         window_length
         ) %>% 
  group_by(clusterID_seq,
           window_type) %>%
  summarise(watershed = first(watershed),
            year = first(year),
            window_length = first(window_length),
            
            # catchment_km2 at downstream terminus of sample window
            catchment_km2 = max(catchment_km2, na.rm = T),
            
            # total riparian area (m^2) in window
            riparian_area_m2 = sum(riparian_area_m2, na.rm = T),
            
            riparian_area_m2_0 = sum(Shape_Area_0, na.rm = T),
            
            riparian_area_m2_10 = sum(Shape_Area_10, na.rm = T),
            
            riparian_area_m2_20 = sum(Shape_Area_20, na.rm = T),
            
            riparian_area_m2_30 = sum(Shape_Area_30, na.rm = T),
            
            # avg TO of window
            TO = mean(TO, na.rm = T),
            
            # avg detection and fals pos. prob. for window
            p_window = mean(p_mean, na.rm = T),
            f_window = mean(f_mean, na.rm = T),
            
            # sum dam counts
            beav_count_all  = sum(dam_count_beav_all, na.rm = TRUE),
            beav_count_conf = sum(dam_count_beav_conf, na.rm = TRUE),
            anthro_count    = sum(dam_count_ant, na.rm = TRUE),
            isAnthro = first(isAnthro),
            
            # compute Nhat:
            Nhat = beav_count_all / (p_window * (1 - f_window)),
  
            # sum total surface water area for window
            SWA_t5 = sum(SWA_t5, na.rm = T),
            SWA_t6 = sum(SWA_t6, na.rm = T),
            SWA_t7 = sum(SWA_t7, na.rm = T),
            SWA_t8 = sum(SWA_t8, na.rm = T),
            
            # sum total veg area for each window at each buffer
            VA_0_t6 = sum(Veg_area_veg23_0, na.rm = T),
           
            
            VA_10_t6 = sum(Veg_area_veg23_10, na.rm = T),
            
            
            VA_20_t6 = sum(Veg_area_veg23_20, na.rm = T),
            
            
            VA_30_t6 = sum(Veg_area_veg23_30, na.rm = T),
            
            
            # mean & sd NDVI for window
            NDVI_0_t6 = mean(NDVI_veg23_0, na.rm = T),
           
            
            NDVI_10_t6 = mean(NDVI_veg23_10, na.rm = T),
            
            
            NDVI_20_t6 = mean(NDVI_veg23_20, na.rm = T),
            
            
            NDVI_30_t6 = mean(NDVI_veg23_30, na.rm = T),
            
            NDVI_sd_0_t6 = sd(NDVI_veg23_0,na.rm=T),
            NDVI_sd_10_t6 = sd(NDVI_veg23_10,na.rm=T),
            NDVI_sd_20_t6 = sd(NDVI_veg23_20,na.rm=T),
            NDVI_sd_30_t6 = sd(NDVI_veg23_30,na.rm=T),

            # take max isNull. if 1, then SWA should = NA due to satellite obfuscation;
            
            containsNull_t5 = max(containsNull_t5),
            containsNull_t6 = max(containsNull_t6),
            containsNull_t7 = max(containsNull_t7),
            containsNull_t8 = max(containsNull_t8),
            
            .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r,echo=FALSE}
# left_join() the SW data to the "..._sampled" data frame for each watershed-year combo

# LARB

# 2019
lrb19_sampledSW_Veg <- lrb19_sampled %>% 
  left_join(lrb_SW_19_collapsed,
            by = "TP_ID") %>% 
  left_join(lrb19_veg,
            by = "TP_ID") %>% 
  select(watershed,
         year,
         clusterID_seq,
         TP_ID,
         window_type,
         catchment_km2,
         riparian_area_m2,
         TO,
         p_mean,
         f_mean,
         dam_count_beav_all,
         dam_count_beav_conf,
         dam_count_ant,
         isAnthro,
         dam_intensity,
         SWA_t5,
         SWA_t6,
         SWA_t7,
         SWA_t8,
         Veg_area_veg19_0,
         Shape_Area_0,
         NDVI_veg19_0,
         Veg_area_veg19_10,
         Shape_Area_10,
         NDVI_veg19_10,
         Veg_area_veg19_20,
         Shape_Area_20,
         NDVI_veg19_20,
         Veg_area_veg19_30,
         Shape_Area_30,
         NDVI_veg19_30,
         containsNull_t5,
         containsNull_t6,
         containsNull_t7,
         containsNull_t8,
         window_start,
         window_end,
         window_length
         ) %>% 
  group_by(clusterID_seq,
           window_type) %>%
  summarise(watershed = first(watershed),
            year = first(year),
            window_length = first(window_length),
            
            # catchment_km2 at downstream terminus of sample window
            catchment_km2 = max(catchment_km2, na.rm = T),
            
            # total riparian area (m^2) in window
            riparian_area_m2 = sum(riparian_area_m2, na.rm = T),
            
            riparian_area_m2_0 = sum(Shape_Area_0, na.rm = T),
            
            riparian_area_m2_10 = sum(Shape_Area_10, na.rm = T),
            
            riparian_area_m2_20 = sum(Shape_Area_20, na.rm = T),
            
            riparian_area_m2_30 = sum(Shape_Area_30, na.rm = T),
            
            # avg TO of window
            TO = mean(TO, na.rm = T),
            
            # avg detection and fals pos. prob. for window
            p_window = mean(p_mean, na.rm = T),
            f_window = mean(f_mean, na.rm = T),
            
            # sum dam counts
            beav_count_all  = sum(dam_count_beav_all, na.rm = TRUE),
            beav_count_conf = sum(dam_count_beav_conf, na.rm = TRUE),
            anthro_count    = sum(dam_count_ant, na.rm = TRUE),
            isAnthro = first(isAnthro),
            
            # compute Nhat:
            Nhat = beav_count_all / (p_window * (1 - f_window)),
  
            # sum total surface water area for window
            SWA_t5 = sum(SWA_t5, na.rm = T),
            SWA_t6 = sum(SWA_t6, na.rm = T),
            SWA_t7 = sum(SWA_t7, na.rm = T),
            SWA_t8 = sum(SWA_t8, na.rm = T),
            
            # sum total veg area for each window at each buffer
            VA_0_t6 = sum(Veg_area_veg19_0, na.rm = T),
           
            
            VA_10_t6 = sum(Veg_area_veg19_10, na.rm = T),
            
            
            VA_20_t6 = sum(Veg_area_veg19_20, na.rm = T),
            
            
            VA_30_t6 = sum(Veg_area_veg19_30, na.rm = T),
            
            
            # mean & sd NDVI for window
            NDVI_0_t6 = mean(NDVI_veg19_0, na.rm = T),
           
            
            NDVI_10_t6 = mean(NDVI_veg19_10, na.rm = T),
            
            
            NDVI_20_t6 = mean(NDVI_veg19_20, na.rm = T),
            
            
            NDVI_30_t6 = mean(NDVI_veg19_30, na.rm = T),
            
            NDVI_sd_0_t6 = sd(NDVI_veg19_0,na.rm=T),
            NDVI_sd_10_t6 = sd(NDVI_veg19_10,na.rm=T),
            NDVI_sd_20_t6 = sd(NDVI_veg19_20,na.rm=T),
            NDVI_sd_30_t6 = sd(NDVI_veg19_30,na.rm=T),

            # take max isNull. if 1, then SWA should = NA due to satellite obfuscation;
            
            containsNull_t5 = max(containsNull_t5),
            containsNull_t6 = max(containsNull_t6),
            containsNull_t7 = max(containsNull_t7),
            containsNull_t8 = max(containsNull_t8),
            
            .groups = "drop"
  )

lrb19_sampled_Long <- lrb19_sampledSW_Veg %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(starts_with("SWA_t"), 
             starts_with("VA_0_t"), 
             starts_with("VA_10_t"),
             starts_with("VA_20_t"),
             starts_with("VA_30_t"),
             starts_with("NDVI_0_t"), 
             starts_with("NDVI_10_t"),
             starts_with("NDVI_20_t"),
             starts_with("NDVI_30_t"),
             starts_with("NDVI_sd_0_t"),
             starts_with("NDVI_sd_10_t"),
             starts_with("NDVI_sd_20_t"),
             starts_with("NDVI_sd_30_t"),
             starts_with("containsNull_t")),
    names_to = c(".value", "t"),
    names_pattern = "(.*)_t(\\d+)"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    t = as.factor(t)
  )

#lrb19_lateSummer_Sample_Long <- lrb19_sampled_Long %>% 
#  filter(t %in% c(5,6,7,8))


# Mask SW/VEG data from windows with Null pixels for time t:

lrb19_sampled_Long <- lrb19_sampled_Long %>% 
  mutate(
    SWA     = ifelse(containsNull >= 1, NA, SWA),
    VA_0      = ifelse(containsNull >= 1, NA, VA_0),
    VA_10      = ifelse(containsNull >= 1, NA, VA_10),
    VA_20      = ifelse(containsNull >= 1, NA, VA_20),
    VA_30      = ifelse(containsNull >= 1, NA, VA_30),
    
    NDVI_0      = ifelse(containsNull >= 1, NA, NDVI_0),
    NDVI_10      = ifelse(containsNull >= 1, NA, NDVI_10),
    NDVI_20      = ifelse(containsNull >= 1, NA, NDVI_20),
    NDVI_30      = ifelse(containsNull >= 1, NA, NDVI_30),
    
    NDVI_sd_0 = ifelse(containsNull >= 1, NA, NDVI_sd_0),
    NDVI_sd_10 = ifelse(containsNull >= 1, NA, NDVI_sd_10),
    NDVI_sd_20 = ifelse(containsNull >= 1, NA, NDVI_sd_20),
    NDVI_sd_30 = ifelse(containsNull >= 1, NA, NDVI_sd_30),
  )

#PLOTS!
#Compare dam counts per sample window
lrb19_damcounts <- lrb19_sampled_Long %>%
  filter(window_type == "dammed") %>%
  select(clusterID_seq, beav_count_all)

lrb19_damcounts <- lrb19_damcounts %>%
  mutate(beav_count_all = beav_count_all,
         clusterID_seq = factor(clusterID_seq)) %>% 
  group_by(clusterID_seq) %>% 
  summarise(beav_count_all = max(beav_count_all))

ggplot(lrb19_damcounts,
       aes(x = beav_count_all,
           fill = factor(clusterID_seq))) +
  geom_bar(color = "black", width = 0.8) +

    name = "Cluster ID"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Dam Count per Cluster Window",
    y = "Number of Dammed Clusters",
    title = "Distribution of Dam Counts Across Sampled Dammed Clusters",
    subtitle = "lrb19"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```

```{r,echo=FALSE}
# left_join() the SW data to the "..._sampled" data frame for each watershed-year combo

# Larb

# 2023
lrb23_sampledSW_Veg <- lrb23_sampled %>% 
  left_join(lrb_SW_23_collapsed,
            by = "TP_ID") %>% 
  left_join(lrb23_veg,
            by = "TP_ID") %>% 
  select(watershed,
         year,
         clusterID_seq,
         TP_ID,
         window_type,
         catchment_km2,
         riparian_area_m2,
         TO,
         p_mean,
         f_mean,
         dam_count_beav_all,
         dam_count_beav_conf,
         dam_count_ant,
         isAnthro,
         dam_intensity,
         SWA_t5,
         SWA_t6,
         SWA_t7,
         SWA_t8,
         Veg_area_veg23_0,
         Shape_Area_0,
         NDVI_veg23_0,
         Veg_area_veg23_10,
         Shape_Area_10,
         NDVI_veg23_10,
         Veg_area_veg23_20,
         Shape_Area_20,
         NDVI_veg23_20,
         Veg_area_veg23_30,
         Shape_Area_30,
         NDVI_veg23_30,
         containsNull_t5,
         containsNull_t6,
         containsNull_t7,
         containsNull_t8,
         window_start,
         window_end,
         window_length
         ) %>% 
  group_by(clusterID_seq,
           window_type) %>%
  summarise(watershed = first(watershed),
            year = first(year),
            window_length = first(window_length),
            
            # catchment_km2 at downstream terminus of sample window
            catchment_km2 = max(catchment_km2, na.rm = T),
            
            # total riparian area (m^2) in window
            riparian_area_m2 = sum(riparian_area_m2, na.rm = T),
            
            riparian_area_m2_0 = sum(Shape_Area_0, na.rm = T),
            
            riparian_area_m2_10 = sum(Shape_Area_10, na.rm = T),
            
            riparian_area_m2_20 = sum(Shape_Area_20, na.rm = T),
            
            riparian_area_m2_30 = sum(Shape_Area_30, na.rm = T),
            
            # avg TO of window
            TO = mean(TO, na.rm = T),
            
            # avg detection and fals pos. prob. for window
            p_window = mean(p_mean, na.rm = T),
            f_window = mean(f_mean, na.rm = T),
            
            # sum dam counts
            beav_count_all  = sum(dam_count_beav_all, na.rm = TRUE),
            beav_count_conf = sum(dam_count_beav_conf, na.rm = TRUE),
            anthro_count    = sum(dam_count_ant, na.rm = TRUE),
            isAnthro = first(isAnthro),
            
            # compute Nhat:
            Nhat = beav_count_all / (p_window * (1 - f_window)),
  
            # sum total surface water area for window
            SWA_t5 = sum(SWA_t5, na.rm = T),
            SWA_t6 = sum(SWA_t6, na.rm = T),
            SWA_t7 = sum(SWA_t7, na.rm = T),
            SWA_t8 = sum(SWA_t8, na.rm = T),
            
            # sum total veg area for each window at each buffer
            VA_0_t6 = sum(Veg_area_veg23_0, na.rm = T),
           
            
            VA_10_t6 = sum(Veg_area_veg23_10, na.rm = T),
            
            
            VA_20_t6 = sum(Veg_area_veg23_20, na.rm = T),
            
            
            VA_30_t6 = sum(Veg_area_veg23_30, na.rm = T),
            
            
            # mean & sd NDVI for window
            NDVI_0_t6 = mean(NDVI_veg23_0, na.rm = T),
           
            
            NDVI_10_t6 = mean(NDVI_veg23_10, na.rm = T),
            
            
            NDVI_20_t6 = mean(NDVI_veg23_20, na.rm = T),
            
            
            NDVI_30_t6 = mean(NDVI_veg23_30, na.rm = T),
            
            NDVI_sd_0_t6 = sd(NDVI_veg23_0,na.rm=T),
            NDVI_sd_10_t6 = sd(NDVI_veg23_10,na.rm=T),
            NDVI_sd_20_t6 = sd(NDVI_veg23_20,na.rm=T),
            NDVI_sd_30_t6 = sd(NDVI_veg23_30,na.rm=T),

            # take max isNull. if 1, then SWA should = NA due to satellite obfuscation;
            
            containsNull_t5 = max(containsNull_t5),
            containsNull_t6 = max(containsNull_t6),
            containsNull_t7 = max(containsNull_t7),
            containsNull_t8 = max(containsNull_t8),
            
            .groups = "drop"
  )

lrb23_sampled_Long <- lrb23_sampledSW_Veg %>%
```

```{r,echo=FALSE}
# left_join() the SW data to the "..._sampled" data frame for each watershed-year combo

# LOWER BEAVER

# 2019
lbv19_sampledSW_Veg <- lbv19_sampled %>% 
  left_join(lbv_SW_19_collapsed,
            by = "TP_ID") %>% 
  left_join(lbv19_veg,
            by = "TP_ID") %>% 
  select(watershed,
         year,
         clusterID_seq,
         TP_ID,
         window_type,
         catchment_km2,
         riparian_area_m2,
         TO,
         p_mean,
         f_mean,
         dam_count_beav_all,
         dam_count_beav_conf,
         dam_count_ant,
         isAnthro,
         dam_intensity,
         SWA_t5,
         SWA_t6,
         SWA_t7,
         SWA_t8,
         Veg_area_veg19_0,
         Shape_Area_0,
         NDVI_veg19_0,
         Veg_area_veg19_10,
         Shape_Area_10,
         NDVI_veg19_10,
         Veg_area_veg19_20,
         Shape_Area_20,
         NDVI_veg19_20,
         Veg_area_veg19_30,
         Shape_Area_30,
         NDVI_veg19_30,
         containsNull_t5,
         containsNull_t6,
         containsNull_t7,
         containsNull_t8,
         window_start,
         window_end,
         window_length
         ) %>% 
  group_by(clusterID_seq,
           window_type) %>%
  summarise(watershed = first(watershed),
            year = first(year),
            window_length = first(window_length),
            
            # catchment_km2 at downstream terminus of sample window
            catchment_km2 = max(catchment_km2, na.rm = T),
            
            # total riparian area (m^2) in window
            riparian_area_m2 = sum(riparian_area_m2, na.rm = T),
            
            riparian_area_m2_0 = sum(Shape_Area_0, na.rm = T),
            
            riparian_area_m2_10 = sum(Shape_Area_10, na.rm = T),
            
            riparian_area_m2_20 = sum(Shape_Area_20, na.rm = T),
            
            riparian_area_m2_30 = sum(Shape_Area_30, na.rm = T),
            
            # avg TO of window
            TO = mean(TO, na.rm = T),
            
            # avg detection and fals pos. prob. for window
            p_window = mean(p_mean, na.rm = T),
            f_window = mean(f_mean, na.rm = T),
            
            # sum dam counts
            beav_count_all  = sum(dam_count_beav_all, na.rm = TRUE),
            beav_count_conf = sum(dam_count_beav_conf, na.rm = TRUE),
            anthro_count    = sum(dam_count_ant, na.rm = TRUE),
            isAnthro = first(isAnthro),
            
            # compute Nhat:
            Nhat = beav_count_all / (p_window * (1 - f_window)),
  
            # sum total surface water area for window
            SWA_t5 = sum(SWA_t5, na.rm = T),
            SWA_t6 = sum(SWA_t6, na.rm = T),
            SWA_t7 = sum(SWA_t7, na.rm = T),
            SWA_t8 = sum(SWA_t8, na.rm = T),
            
            # sum total veg area for each window at each buffer
            VA_0_t6 = sum(Veg_area_veg19_0, na.rm = T),
           
            
            VA_10_t6 = sum(Veg_area_veg19_10, na.rm = T),
            
            
            VA_20_t6 = sum(Veg_area_veg19_20, na.rm = T),
            
            
            VA_30_t6 = sum(Veg_area_veg19_30, na.rm = T),
            
            
            # mean & sd NDVI for window
            NDVI_0_t6 = mean(NDVI_veg19_0, na.rm = T),
           
            
            NDVI_10_t6 = mean(NDVI_veg19_10, na.rm = T),
            
            
            NDVI_20_t6 = mean(NDVI_veg19_20, na.rm = T),
            
            
            NDVI_30_t6 = mean(NDVI_veg19_30, na.rm = T),
            
            NDVI_sd_0_t6 = sd(NDVI_veg19_0,na.rm=T),
            NDVI_sd_10_t6 = sd(NDVI_veg19_10,na.rm=T),
            NDVI_sd_20_t6 = sd(NDVI_veg19_20,na.rm=T),
            NDVI_sd_30_t6 = sd(NDVI_veg19_30,na.rm=T),

            # take max isNull. if 1, then SWA should = NA due to satellite obfuscation;
            
            containsNull_t5 = max(containsNull_t5),
            containsNull_t6 = max(containsNull_t6),
            containsNull_t7 = max(containsNull_t7),
            containsNull_t8 = max(containsNull_t8),
            
            .groups = "drop"
  )

lbv19_sampled_Long <- lbv19_sampledSW_Veg %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(starts_with("SWA_t"), 
             starts_with("VA_0_t"), 
             starts_with("VA_10_t"),
             starts_with("VA_20_t"),
             starts_with("VA_30_t"),
             starts_with("NDVI_0_t"),

             starts_with("NDVI_20_t"),
             starts_with("NDVI_30_t"),
             starts_with("NDVI_sd_0_t"),
             starts_with("NDVI_sd_10_t"),
             starts_with("NDVI_sd_20_t"),
             starts_with("NDVI_sd_30_t"),
             starts_with("containsNull_t")),
    names_to = c(".value", "t"),
    names_pattern = "(.*)_t(\\d+)"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    t = as.factor(t)
  )
```

```{r,echo=FALSE}
# left_join() the SW data to the "..._sampled" data frame for each watershed-year combo

# Lower Beaver

# 2023
lbv23_sampledSW_Veg <- lbv23_sampled %>% 
  left_join(lbv_SW_23_collapsed,
            by = "TP_ID") %>% 
  left_join(lbv23_veg,
            by = "TP_ID") %>% 
  select(watershed,
         year,
         clusterID_seq,
         TP_ID,
         window_type,
         catchment_km2,
         riparian_area_m2,
         TO,
         p_mean,
         f_mean,
         dam_count_beav_all,
         dam_count_beav_conf,
         dam_count_ant,
         isAnthro,
         dam_intensity,
         SWA_t5,
         SWA_t6,
         SWA_t7,
         SWA_t8,
         Veg_area_veg23_0,
         Shape_Area_0,
         NDVI_veg23_0,
         Veg_area_veg23_10,
         Shape_Area_10,
         NDVI_veg23_10,
         Veg_area_veg23_20,
         Shape_Area_20,
         NDVI_veg23_20,
         Veg_area_veg23_30,
         Shape_Area_30,
         NDVI_veg23_30,
         containsNull_t5,
         containsNull_t6,
         containsNull_t7,
         containsNull_t8,
         window_start,
         window_end,
         window_length
         ) %>% 
  group_by(clusterID_seq,
           window_type) %>%
  summarise(watershed = first(watershed),
            year = first(year),
            window_length = first(window_length),
            
            # catchment_km2 at downstream terminus of sample window
            catchment_km2 = max(catchment_km2, na.rm = T),
            
            # total riparian area (m^2) in window
            riparian_area_m2 = sum(riparian_area_m2, na.rm = T),
            
            riparian_area_m2_0 = sum(Shape_Area_0, na.rm = T),
            
            riparian_area_m2_10 = sum(Shape_Area_10, na.rm = T),
            
            riparian_area_m2_20 = sum(Shape_Area_20, na.rm = T),
            
            riparian_area_m2_30 = sum(Shape_Area_30, na.rm = T),
            
            # avg TO of window
            TO = mean(TO, na.rm = T),
            
            # avg detection and fals pos. prob. for window
            p_window = mean(p_mean, na.rm = T),
            f_window = mean(f_mean, na.rm = T),
            
            # sum dam counts
            beav_count_all  = sum(dam_count_beav_all, na.rm = TRUE),
            beav_count_conf = sum(dam_count_beav_conf, na.rm = TRUE),
            anthro_count    = sum(dam_count_ant, na.rm = TRUE),
            isAnthro = first(isAnthro),
            
            # compute Nhat:
            Nhat = beav_count_all / (p_window * (1 - f_window)),
  
            # sum total surface water area for window
            SWA_t5 = sum(SWA_t5, na.rm = T),
            SWA_t6 = sum(SWA_t6, na.rm = T),
            SWA_t7 = sum(SWA_t7, na.rm = T),
            SWA_t8 = sum(SWA_t8, na.rm = T),
            
            # sum total veg area for each window at each buffer
            VA_0_t6 = sum(Veg_area_veg23_0, na.rm = T),
           
            
            VA_10_t6 = sum(Veg_area_veg23_10, na.rm = T),
            
            
            VA_20_t6 = sum(Veg_area_veg23_20, na.rm = T),
            
            
            VA_30_t6 = sum(Veg_area_veg23_30, na.rm = T),
            
            
            # mean & sd NDVI for window
            NDVI_0_t6 = mean(NDVI_veg23_0, na.rm = T),
           
            
            NDVI_10_t6 = mean(NDVI_veg23_10, na.rm = T),
            
            
            NDVI_20_t6 = mean(NDVI_veg23_20, na.rm = T),
            
            
            NDVI_30_t6 = mean(NDVI_veg23_30, na.rm = T),
            
            NDVI_sd_0_t6 = sd(NDVI_veg23_0,na.rm=T),
            NDVI_sd_10_t6 = sd(NDVI_veg23_10,na.rm=T),
            NDVI_sd_20_t6 = sd(NDVI_veg23_20,na.rm=T),
            NDVI_sd_30_t6 = sd(NDVI_veg23_30,na.rm=T),

            # take max isNull. if 1, then SWA should = NA due to satellite obfuscation;
            
            containsNull_t5 = max(containsNull_t5),
            containsNull_t6 = max(containsNull_t6),
            containsNull_t7 = max(containsNull_t7),
            containsNull_t8 = max(containsNull_t8),
            
            .groups = "drop"
  )

lbv23_sampled_Long <- lbv23_sampledSW_Veg %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(starts_with("SWA_t"), 
             starts_with("VA_0_t"), 
             starts_with("VA_10_t"),
             starts_with("VA_20_t"),
             starts_with("VA_30_t"),
             starts_with("NDVI_0_t"), 
             starts_with("NDVI_10_t"),
             starts_with("NDVI_20_t"),
             starts_with("NDVI_30_t"),
             starts_with("NDVI_sd_0_t"),
             starts_with("NDVI_sd_10_t"),
             starts_with("NDVI_sd_20_t"),
             starts_with("NDVI_sd_30_t"),
             starts_with("containsNull_t")),
    names_to = c(".value", "t"),
    names_pattern = "(.*)_t(\\d+)"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    t = as.factor(t)
  )
```

```{r,echo=FALSE}
# left_join() the SW data to the "..._sampled" data frame for each watershed-year combo

# UPPER BEAVER

# 2019
ubv19_sampledSW_Veg <- ubv19_sampled %>% 
  left_join(ubv_SW_19_collapsed,
            by = "TP_ID") %>% 
  left_join(ubv19_veg,
            by = "TP_ID") %>% 
  select(watershed,
         year,
         clusterID_seq,
         TP_ID,
         window_type,
         catchment_km2,
         riparian_area_m2,
         TO,
         p_mean,
         f_mean,
         dam_count_beav_all,
         dam_count_beav_conf,
         dam_count_ant,
         isAnthro,
         dam_intensity,
         SWA_t5,
         SWA_t6,
         SWA_t7,
         SWA_t8,
         Veg_area_veg19_0,
         Shape_Area_0,
         NDVI_veg19_0,
         Veg_area_veg19_10,
         Shape_Area_10,
         NDVI_veg19_10,
         Veg_area_veg19_20,
         Shape_Area_20,
         NDVI_veg19_20,
         Veg_area_veg19_30,
         Shape_Area_30,
         NDVI_veg19_30,
         containsNull_t5,
         containsNull_t6,
         containsNull_t7,
         containsNull_t8,
         window_start,
         window_end,
         window_length
         ) %>% 
  group_by(clusterID_seq,
           window_type) %>%
  summarise(watershed = first(watershed),
            year = first(year),
            window_length = first(window_length),
            
            # catchment_km2 at downstream terminus of sample window
            catchment_km2 = max(catchment_km2, na.rm = T),
            
            # total riparian area (m^2) in window
            riparian_area_m2 = sum(riparian_area_m2, na.rm = T),
            
            riparian_area_m2_0 = sum(Shape_Area_0, na.rm = T),
            
            riparian_area_m2_10 = sum(Shape_Area_10, na.rm = T),
            
            riparian_area_m2_20 = sum(Shape_Area_20, na.rm = T),
            
            riparian_area_m2_30 = sum(Shape_Area_30, na.rm = T),
            
            # avg TO of window
            TO = mean(TO, na.rm = T),
            
            # avg detection and fals pos. prob. for window
            p_window = mean(p_mean, na.rm = T),
            f_window = mean(f_mean, na.rm = T),
            
            # sum dam counts
            beav_count_all  = sum(dam_count_beav_all, na.rm = TRUE),
            beav_count_conf = sum(dam_count_beav_conf, na.rm = TRUE),
            anthro_count    = sum(dam_count_ant, na.rm = TRUE),
            isAnthro = first(isAnthro),
            
            # compute Nhat:
            Nhat = beav_count_all / (p_window * (1 - f_window)),
  
            # sum total surface water area for window
            SWA_t5 = sum(SWA_t5, na.rm = T),
            SWA_t6 = sum(SWA_t6, na.rm = T),
            SWA_t7 = sum(SWA_t7, na.rm = T),
            SWA_t8 = sum(SWA_t8, na.rm = T),
            
            # sum total veg area for each window at each buffer
            VA_0_t6 = sum(Veg_area_veg19_0, na.rm = T),
           
            
            VA_10_t6 = sum(Veg_area_veg19_10, na.rm = T),
            
            
            VA_20_t6 = sum(Veg_area_veg19_20, na.rm = T),
            
            
            VA_30_t6 = sum(Veg_area_veg19_30, na.rm = T),
            
            
            # mean & sd NDVI for window
            NDVI_0_t6 = mean(NDVI_veg19_0, na.rm = T),
           
            
            NDVI_10_t6 = mean(NDVI_veg19_10, na.rm = T),
            
            
            NDVI_20_t6 = mean(NDVI_veg19_20, na.rm = T),
            
            
            NDVI_30_t6 = mean(NDVI_veg19_30, na.rm = T),
            
            NDVI_sd_0_t6 = sd(NDVI_veg19_0,na.rm=T),
            NDVI_sd_10_t6 = sd(NDVI_veg19_10,na.rm=T),
            NDVI_sd_20_t6 = sd(NDVI_veg19_20,na.rm=T),
            NDVI_sd_30_t6 = sd(NDVI_veg19_30,na.rm=T),

            # take max isNull. if 1, then SWA should = NA due to satellite obfuscation;
            
            containsNull_t5 = max(containsNull_t5),
            containsNull_t6 = max(containsNull_t6),
            containsNull_t7 = max(containsNull_t7),
            containsNull_t8 = max(containsNull_t8),
            
            .groups = "drop"
  )

ubv19_sampled_Long <- ubv19_sampledSW_Veg %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(starts_with("SWA_t"), 
             starts_with("VA_0_t"), 
             starts_with("VA_10_t"),
             starts_with("VA_20_t"),
             starts_with("VA_30_t"),
             starts_with("NDVI_0_t"), 
             starts_with("NDVI_10_t"),
             starts_with("NDVI_20_t"),
             starts_with("NDVI_30_t"),
             starts_with("NDVI_sd_0_t"),
             starts_with("NDVI_sd_10_t"),
             starts_with("NDVI_sd_20_t"),
             starts_with("NDVI_sd_30_t"),
             starts_with("containsNull_t")),
    names_to = c(".value", "t"),
    names_pattern = "(.*)_t(\\d+)"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    t = as.factor(t)
  )

# Mask SW/VEG data from windows with Null pixels for time t:

    VA_20      = ifelse(containsNull >= 1, NA, VA_20),

    NDVI_0      = ifelse(containsNull >= 1, NA, NDVI_0),
    NDVI_10      = ifelse(containsNull >= 1, NA, NDVI_10),
    NDVI_20      = ifelse(containsNull >= 1, NA, NDVI_20),
    NDVI_30      = ifelse(containsNull >= 1, NA, NDVI_30),
    
    NDVI_sd_0 = ifelse(containsNull >= 1, NA, NDVI_sd_0),
    NDVI_sd_10 = ifelse(containsNull >= 1, NA, NDVI_sd_10),
    NDVI_sd_20 = ifelse(containsNull >= 1, NA, NDVI_sd_20),

  )

#PLOTS!
#Compare dam counts per sample window
ubv19_damcounts <- ubv19_sampled_Long %>%
  filter(window_type == "dammed") %>%
  select(clusterID_seq, beav_count_all)

ubv19_damcounts <- ubv19_damcounts %>%
  mutate(beav_count_all = beav_count_all,
         clusterID_seq = factor(clusterID_seq)) %>% 
  group_by(clusterID_seq) %>% 
  summarise(beav_count_all = max(beav_count_all))

ggplot(ubv19_damcounts,
       aes(x = beav_count_all,
           fill = factor(clusterID_seq))) +
  geom_bar(color = "black", width = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(

    name = "Cluster ID"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Dam Count per Cluster Window",
    y = "Number of Dammed Clusters",
    title = "Distribution of Dam Counts Across Sampled Dammed Clusters",
    subtitle = "ubv19"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```

```{r,echo=FALSE}
# left_join() the SW data to the "..._sampled" data frame for each watershed-year combo

# Upper Beaver

# 2023
ubv23_sampledSW_Veg <- ubv23_sampled %>% 
  left_join(ubv_SW_23_collapsed,
            by = "TP_ID") %>% 
  left_join(ubv23_veg,
            by = "TP_ID") %>% 
  select(watershed,
         year,
         clusterID_seq,
         TP_ID,
         window_type,
         catchment_km2,
         riparian_area_m2,
         TO,
         p_mean,
         f_mean,
         dam_count_beav_all,
         dam_count_beav_conf,
         dam_count_ant,
         isAnthro,
         dam_intensity,
         SWA_t5,
         SWA_t6,
         SWA_t7,
         SWA_t8,
         Veg_area_veg23_0,
         Shape_Area_0,
         NDVI_veg23_0,
         Veg_area_veg23_10,
         Shape_Area_10,
         NDVI_veg23_10,
         Veg_area_veg23_20,
         Shape_Area_20,
         NDVI_veg23_20,
         Veg_area_veg23_30,
         Shape_Area_30,
         NDVI_veg23_30,
         containsNull_t5,
         containsNull_t6,
         containsNull_t7,
         containsNull_t8,
         window_start,
         window_end,
         window_length
         ) %>% 
  group_by(clusterID_seq,
           window_type) %>%
  summarise(watershed = first(watershed),
            year = first(year),
            window_length = first(window_length),
            
            # catchment_km2 at downstream terminus of sample window
            catchment_km2 = max(catchment_km2, na.rm = T),
            
            # total riparian area (m^2) in window
            riparian_area_m2 = sum(riparian_area_m2, na.rm = T),
            
            riparian_area_m2_0 = sum(Shape_Area_0, na.rm = T),
            
            riparian_area_m2_10 = sum(Shape_Area_10, na.rm = T),
            
            riparian_area_m2_20 = sum(Shape_Area_20, na.rm = T),
            
            riparian_area_m2_30 = sum(Shape_Area_30, na.rm = T),
            
            # avg TO of window
            TO = mean(TO, na.rm = T),
            
            # avg detection and fals pos. prob. for window
            p_window = mean(p_mean, na.rm = T),
            f_window = mean(f_mean, na.rm = T),
            
            # sum dam counts
            beav_count_all  = sum(dam_count_beav_all, na.rm = TRUE),
            beav_count_conf = sum(dam_count_beav_conf, na.rm = TRUE),
            anthro_count    = sum(dam_count_ant, na.rm = TRUE),
            isAnthro = first(isAnthro),
            
            # compute Nhat:
            Nhat = beav_count_all / (p_window * (1 - f_window)),
  
            # sum total surface water area for window
            SWA_t5 = sum(SWA_t5, na.rm = T),
            SWA_t6 = sum(SWA_t6, na.rm = T),
            SWA_t7 = sum(SWA_t7, na.rm = T),
            SWA_t8 = sum(SWA_t8, na.rm = T),
            
            # sum total veg area for each window at each buffer
            VA_0_t6 = sum(Veg_area_veg23_0, na.rm = T),
           
            
            VA_10_t6 = sum(Veg_area_veg23_10, na.rm = T),
            
            
            VA_20_t6 = sum(Veg_area_veg23_20, na.rm = T),
            
            
            VA_30_t6 = sum(Veg_area_veg23_30, na.rm = T),
            
            
            # mean & sd NDVI for window
            NDVI_0_t6 = mean(NDVI_veg23_0, na.rm = T),
           
            
            NDVI_10_t6 = mean(NDVI_veg23_10, na.rm = T),
            
            
            NDVI_20_t6 = mean(NDVI_veg23_20, na.rm = T),
            
            
            NDVI_30_t6 = mean(NDVI_veg23_30, na.rm = T),
            
            NDVI_sd_0_t6 = sd(NDVI_veg23_0,na.rm=T),
            NDVI_sd_10_t6 = sd(NDVI_veg23_10,na.rm=T),
            NDVI_sd_20_t6 = sd(NDVI_veg23_20,na.rm=T),
            NDVI_sd_30_t6 = sd(NDVI_veg23_30,na.rm=T),

            # take max isNull. if 1, then SWA should = NA due to satellite obfuscation;
            
            containsNull_t5 = max(containsNull_t5),
            containsNull_t6 = max(containsNull_t6),
            containsNull_t7 = max(containsNull_t7),
            containsNull_t8 = max(containsNull_t8),
            
            .groups = "drop"
  )

ubv23_sampled_Long <- ubv23_sampledSW_Veg %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(starts_with("SWA_t"), 
             starts_with("VA_0_t"), 
             starts_with("VA_10_t"),
             starts_with("VA_20_t"),
             starts_with("VA_30_t"),
             starts_with("NDVI_0_t"), 
             starts_with("NDVI_10_t"),
             starts_with("NDVI_20_t"),
             starts_with("NDVI_30_t"),
             starts_with("NDVI_sd_0_t"),
             starts_with("NDVI_sd_10_t"),
             starts_with("NDVI_sd_20_t"),
             starts_with("NDVI_sd_30_t"),
             starts_with("containsNull_t")),
    names_to = c(".value", "t"),
    names_pattern = "(.*)_t(\\d+)"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    t = as.factor(t)
  )

#ubv23_lateSummer_Sample_Long <- ubv23_sampled_Long %>% 
#  filter(t %in% c(5,6,7,8))


# Mask SW/VEG data from windows with Null pixels for time t:

ubv23_sampled_Long <- ubv23_sampled_Long %>% 
  mutate(
    SWA     = ifelse(containsNull >= 1, NA, SWA),
    VA_0      = ifelse(containsNull >= 1, NA, VA_0),
    VA_10      = ifelse(containsNull >= 1, NA, VA_10),
    VA_20      = ifelse(containsNull >= 1, NA, VA_20),
    VA_30      = ifelse(containsNull >= 1, NA, VA_30),
    
    NDVI_0      = ifelse(containsNull >= 1, NA, NDVI_0),
    NDVI_10      = ifelse(containsNull >= 1, NA, NDVI_10),
    NDVI_20      = ifelse(containsNull >= 1, NA, NDVI_20),
    NDVI_30      = ifelse(containsNull >= 1, NA, NDVI_30),
    
    NDVI_sd_0 = ifelse(containsNull >= 1, NA, NDVI_sd_0),
    NDVI_sd_10 = ifelse(containsNull >= 1, NA, NDVI_sd_10),
    NDVI_sd_20 = ifelse(containsNull >= 1, NA, NDVI_sd_20),
    NDVI_sd_30 = ifelse(containsNull >= 1, NA, NDVI_sd_30),
  )
```

CONSIDER ANTHROPOGENIC INFLUENCE:

First, what proportion of each watershed is influenced by anthropogenically impounded features? NOTE: this includes actively and formerly impounding structures.(e.g., Forest Res. on WC is included though its dam is breached)


```{r,echo=FALSE}
# Willow:
# 2019:
wc19AnthroImpact <- length(wc19_anthro_influence_500)
wc19TotalLength <- length(wcRIP_Area_TO_UDA_uniqueID_detDat19_dam19$TP_ID)

wc19PropAnthro <- wc19AnthroImpact/wc19TotalLength

anthro_df <- data.frame(
  stream = rep(c("Willow", "Lone Tree", "Brazil", "Larb", "Lower Beaver", "Upper Beaver"), each = 3),
  year   = rep(c(2019, 2021, 2023), times = 6),
  prop   = c(
    wc19PropAnthro, wc21PropAnthro, wc23PropAnthro,
    lt19PropAnthro, lt21PropAnthro, lt23PropAnthro,
    brz19PropAnthro, brz21PropAnthro, brz23PropAnthro,
    lrb19PropAnthro, lrb21PropAnthro, lrb23PropAnthro,
    lbv19PropAnthro, lbv21PropAnthro, lbv23PropAnthro,
    ubv19PropAnthro, ubv21PropAnthro, ubv23PropAnthro
  )
)




# Visualize anthropogenic pressure:
#library(ggplot2)

ggplot(anthro_df, aes(x = factor(year), y = prop, fill = stream)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = "Proportion of riparian polys influenced by anthro pressure",
    fill = "Stream",
    title = "Anthropogenic Pressure by Stream and Year"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)
```
